en-US.description: A local-first AI workspace for multi-agent chat, coding, and visual workflows.
en-US.longDescription: A local-first AI workspace for multi-agent chat, coding, and visual workflows. Available as a desktop app and self-hosted web console, with support for Hermes Agent, Ekko Agent, and 14 coding-agent integrations, including Claude Code and Codex. Bring conversations, group collaboration, voice, files, and devices together in one place.

zh-CN.description: 本地优先的 AI 工作区，支持多 Agent 聊天、编码和可视化工作流。
zh-CN.longDescription: 本地优先的 AI 工作区，支持多 Agent 聊天、编码和可视化工作流。提供桌面应用和可自托管的 Web 控制台，支持 Hermes Agent、Ekko Agent，以及包含 Claude Code、Codex 在内的 14 种 Coding Agent 集成。在同一个工作区中管理对话、群组协作、语音、文件和设备。
zh-CN.name: Ekko Studio
zh-CN.releaseNotes:
更新重点
- 新增自动 API 模式，可按已知连接和模型匹配协议，兼容带服务商前缀的模型名称；新建连接仍默认 Chat Completions (#3469)
- 桌面端新增本机与远程设备切换和设备管理，替换旧的局域网配对入口 (#3464)
- 模型 API 新增云端访问、密钥可用模型限制和累计美元预算，恢复 Agent 用量细分，并修复面板宽度 (#3440、#3450)
- 支持通过桌面端和网页链接导入服务商，导入前可确认并补全连接信息 (#3438)
- Ekko 电脑操作新增可选的 JEV 元素语义匹配与结果验证，可分别开启或关闭 (#3463)
- 内置浏览器的新建配置默认使用系统代理，减少连接配置步骤 (#3455)
- 修复 DSH ACP 0.2.1 的对话轮次保存兼容性，确保回复结束后正确保存会话 (#3452)
- 聊天附件改为按实际运行的 Profile 校验权限，修复切换 Profile 后的附件鉴权错误 (#3439)
- 完善 TOS 7 安装、升级、卸载和反向代理入口，新增隐私政策入口并更新存在漏洞的依赖 (#3466)
- 新增 M5Stack Cardputer-Adv 局域网固件开发预览，支持文字与短语音聊天，供已有兼容分区布局的设备手动升级 (#3451)
- Studio 与桌面端版本同步更新为 0.7.38，前端更新日志覆盖 12 种语言并保留最近三个版本 (#3472)。
What's Changed
- fix(chat): authorize attachment runs against their resolved profile by @widechaos in https://github.com/EKKOLearnAI/ekko-studio/pull/3439
- feat(esp32-s3): add M5Stack Cardputer-Adv LAN firmware preview by @thursdaycapital in https://github.com/EKKOLearnAI/ekko-studio/pull/3451
- [codex] make Model API panel fill available width by @EKKOLearnAI in https://github.com/EKKOLearnAI/ekko-studio/pull/3450
- [codex] fix DSH ACP 0.2.1-rc.2 turn persistence compatibility by @EKKOLearnAI in https://github.com/EKKOLearnAI/ekko-studio/pull/3452
- feat(models): import providers through desktop and web links by @wtj-0527 in https://github.com/EKKOLearnAI/ekko-studio/pull/3438
- fix: use system proxy by default for browser profiles by @wtj-0527 in https://github.com/EKKOLearnAI/ekko-studio/pull/3455
- [codex] add JEV matching and verification to Ekko Computer Use by @EKKOLearnAI in https://github.com/EKKOLearnAI/ekko-studio/pull/3463
- [codex] add cloud Model API access, key controls and Agent usage by @EKKOLearnAI in https://github.com/EKKOLearnAI/ekko-studio/pull/3440
- [codex] add desktop device switching and retire LAN pairing by @EKKOLearnAI in https://github.com/EKKOLearnAI/ekko-studio/pull/3464
- [codex] wait for device Close button before native pointer test by @EKKOLearnAI in https://github.com/EKKOLearnAI/ekko-studio/pull/3468
- fix(tos): remediate review lifecycle and package compliance findings by @wtj-0527 in https://github.com/EKKOLearnAI/ekko-studio/pull/3466
- Add automatic API mode and match namespaced model IDs by @EKKOLearnAI in https://github.com/EKKOLearnAI/ekko-studio/pull/3469
- chore: prepare Studio 0.7.38 with localized changelog by @EKKOLearnAI in https://github.com/EKKOLearnAI/ekko-studio/pull/3472
Full Changelog: https://github.com/EKKOLearnAI/ekko-studio/compare/v0.7.37...v0.7.38
